name: Nishiaizu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nishiaizu town emblem in white: an outlined ring above a stylised device of two crossed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nishiaizu, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 November 1973; the emblem dates from 20 September 1954.

features.role: Nishiaizu town emblem — an outlined ring above a stylised device of two crossed strokes
